parts.name: Root
parts.description: The stateful container. Owns the committed time value, the popover open state, and the granularity/hour-cycle configuration shared by the input and clock.

props.name: id
props.description: Id applied to the root element. Auto-generated when omitted.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled time value ('HH:mm' or 'HH:mm:ss'). Bindable. null represents the empty state.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial time value when uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when the committed time value changes. Wheel selection commits immediately on snap.

props.name: minValue
props.description: Earliest selectable time. Out-of-range wheel items are disabled; typed values mark the input invalid. Midnight-wrapping ranges are not supported.

props.name: maxValue
props.description: Latest selectable time. Out-of-range wheel items are disabled; typed values mark the input invalid.

props.name: hourCycle
props.description: Forces 12- or 24-hour rendering. Defaults to the active locale. 12-hour mode adds an AM/PM segment and day-period column; values stay normalized to 24-hour.

props.name: granularity
props.description: Smallest editable unit: 'hour', 'minute', or 'second'. 'hour' emits HH:00 values.

props.name: hourStep
props.description: Increment between selectable hours.

props.name: minuteStep
props.description: Increment between selectable minutes.

props.name: secondStep
props.description: Increment between selectable seconds.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the input segments, trigger, and wheels.

props.name: readonly
props.description: Keeps the input focusable while preventing edits.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the time picker as required for form validation.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled popover open state. Bindable.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial popover open state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the popover opens or closes; details include the reason and a cancel() escape hatch.

props.name: children
props.description: TimePicker parts to compose inside the root.

props.name: element
props.description: Bindable reference to the rendered root element.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label for the time picker when no visible label is associated.

parts.name: Input
parts.description: The segmented time input. Iterates the locale-resolved segments and passes each to the children snippet.

props.name: children
props.description: Renders one segment per part; receives the segment descriptor. Defaults to plain segments.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label for the segmented input.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the time picker is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while focus should be visibly indicated (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-within
dataAttributes.description: Present while a segment inside the input has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present while the current segment draft is not committable.

dataAttributes.name: data-open
dataAttributes.description: Present while the popover is open.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the time picker is readonly.

parts.name: Segment
parts.description: One editable or literal segment of the time (hour, minute, second, day period, or separator). Supports typing and arrow-key stepping.

props.name: segment
props.description: The segment descriptor, as received from the Input children snippet.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while focus should be visibly indicated (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the segment has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-placeholder
dataAttributes.description: Present while the segment shows its placeholder instead of a value.

dataAttributes.name: data-time-picker-segment
dataAttributes.description: Identifies a time picker segment element.

dataAttributes.name: data-type
dataAttributes.description: The segment type, e.g. 'hour', 'minute', 'second', 'dayPeriod', or 'literal'.

parts.name: Trigger
parts.description: Button that opens and closes the clock popover.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the button, e.g. a clock icon.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while focus should be visibly indicated (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the trigger has focus.

parts.name: Popover
parts.description: The floating panel that hosts the clock. Forwards Popover.Content props (placement, offset, shouldFlip, …); open state, trigger wiring, and id are controlled internally. Placement defaults to bottom and initial focus lands on the first wheel column.

parts.name: Clock
parts.description: The wheel surface inside the popover. Resolves visible columns from root state (granularity, hourCycle) in stable order: hour → minute? → second? → dayPeriod?.

props.name: column
props.description: Custom per-column rendering; receives { type, label? } for each visible column. Defaults to auto-rendered columns.

dataAttributes.name: data-clock
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the clock element.

parts.name: WheelColumn
parts.description: One scrollable wheel (role="spinbutton") for one editable segment: hour, minute, second, or dayPeriod.

props.name: type
props.description: Which segment this wheel edits: 'hour', 'minute', 'second', or 'dayPeriod'.

props.name: children
props.description: Renders one item per option; receives the wheel option for the column.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name for the column. Defaults to the localized segment label.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while focus should be visibly indicated (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-within
dataAttributes.description: Present while the column contains focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-wheel-highlight
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the column's central highlight band.

dataAttributes.name: data-wheel-spacer
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the padding spacers that let edge items reach the center.

parts.name: WheelItem
parts.description: Headless item inside a wheel column. Renders one option and exposes its state through data attributes, leaving all visual styling to consumers.

props.name: type
props.description: The segment type of the column this item belongs to.

props.name: option
props.description: The wheel option to render, as received from the column's children snippet.

props.name: selected
props.description: Marks the item as selected. Resolved from root state when rendered via the column snippet.

props.name: onRequestCenter
props.description: Called when the item requests to be scrolled to the center of the wheel.

dataAttributes.name: data-centered
dataAttributes.description: Present while the item sits in the center of the wheel.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the item cannot be selected (out of range or stepped out).

dataAttributes.name: data-selected
dataAttributes.description: Present when the item is the committed value for its column.

dataAttributes.name: data-type
dataAttributes.description: The segment type of the item's column.

dataAttributes.name: data-value
dataAttributes.description: The option value the item represents.

dataAttributes.name: data-wheel-item
dataAttributes.description: Identifies a wheel item element.
